tasks.short: Review biofuels production records for abnormalities

steps.what: Select production logs and define the reporting period and comparison basis
Gather logs, datasheets and reports into a comparable production view
Review production levels and identify equipment or process abnormalities

tasks.design: Configure native {OPS_SYSTEM} reports and {BI} to gather selected records and show fixed comparisons. The manager still checks gaps, evaluates production adequacy and identifies abnormalities; the view does not decide that equipment is safe.
tasks.previous_blocker: Review can involve repeated gathering and alignment of separate logs.
tasks.enabler_now: Saved queries can reuse agreed keys and units without interpreting plant behaviour.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising a process abnormality when records are incomplete or operating conditions change.
tasks.human_edge: The manager connects recorded deviations with actual plant operation.
tasks.altitude: Less record gathering while production interpretation stays human.

reach.task: Coordinate investigation of inconsistent production records

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: saved operational queries can gather and align records; the proposed biofuels review saving is unmeasured and does not automate abnormality judgement.

assumptions: Boundary is retrospective record review, separate from real-time meter monitoring in task 15458 and dangerous-material monitoring in task 15451.

In s1 the manager captures site, equipment and batch IDs, period, source references, units, comparison formulas and versions of existing operating specifications; all capture time remains in the 20% share.

Operators and instruments produce timestamped readings, batch quantities, equipment events and recorded observations in the unchanged operational process. Missing keys, incompatible units or ambiguous free-text entries stay visible for manual review in s3; no new structured abnormality code is assumed free.

Test native reports first; existing automatic collection earns no new saving. Seven extra focal hours cover changed comparisons and unusual data exceptions, and 4 other-role hours count data-administrator mapping maintenance.
unknowns: Common record keys and actual manual gathering time
research_questions: Does a source-complete comparison reduce gathering time after exception handling is counted?

already_counted.description: Scope selection and structured comparison capture

incremental.description: Comparison changes and additional data exceptions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=20+50=70; gross 30%, net 23% after 7 focal upkeep. Range covers existing automated comparisons with no new saving through 19 points of gathering removed minus 7 upkeep. Interpretation retains its full share.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Monitor biofuels equipment and implement corrective measures

steps.what: Monitor meters, flow gauges and real-time equipment data
Implement corrective measures for biofuels production equipment as needed

tasks.design: The manager reads existing process-control displays {OTHER} and chooses corrective measures within authorised procedures. Existing automatic regulation remains outside the human-time saving claim.
tasks.previous_blocker: Correct intervention depends on actual operating conditions and the meaning of a reading.
tasks.enabler_now: Current instrumentation supports monitoring without proving that human oversight can be removed.
tasks.still_hard: Responding to conflicting readings or an unfamiliar equipment response.
tasks.human_edge: The manager recognises uncertainty and coordinates a safe response.
tasks.altitude: Monitoring and corrective authority remain unchanged.

reach.task: Coordinate response to abnormal process conditions

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: existing automated control runtime is not manager labour; removing human monitoring or intervention requires a separate demonstrated control-system change.

assumptions: Boundary covers manager monitoring and corrective work, not existing closed-loop regulation or retrospective reports in task 15456.

OTHER means plant process-control system. Existing instruments produce readings; the manager interprets them in s1 and produces the corrective need before s2. No ready-made safe-action flag is assumed.
The manager checks the exact intervention and existing authority during s2 before acting, then observes the response within s2. Use native displays first; no new control code is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new automation or sensing is introduced.
unknowns: Manager's operating authority and existing control architecture
research_questions: Which interventions require direct site assessment in addition to instrument readings?

already_counted.description: Intervention approval, execution and response observation

approvals.approved_version: Exact equipment, current operating assessment, procedure version, intervention and settings checked in s2 before action; changed conditions void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=60+40=100; net 0%. Existing controller runtime and unchanged monitoring earn no labour saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Provide training to improve biofuels plant safety or production

tasks.design: The manager teaches and observes plant practice using current procedures in {DOCS}. Instruction and feedback remain human; no new training-material preparation baseline is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Practical understanding needs observation and responsive explanation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing procedures support demonstrations without replacing live training.
tasks.still_hard: Identifying unsafe habits hidden by a correct verbal answer.
tasks.human_edge: The manager notices uncertainty and adjusts supervision.
tasks.altitude: Training responsibility and contact time stay unchanged.

reach.task: Coordinate practical training with plant supervision

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: observed safety and production training remains human in this design.

assumptions: Boundary is training delivery, excluding separate course authoring and attendance administration.
The manager checks learning needs and selects current procedures during s1. Employees produce practice after instruction within s1; no structured competence score is assumed.
Check existing document and learning functions first; native runtime earns no labour saving.
Zero new upkeep because no application or assessment process is added.
unknowns: Training format and practical supervision needs
research_questions: Which parts of training depend on observing the employee at the equipment?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; net 0%. All live training time remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Monitor dangerous feedstock transport and storage

steps.what: Monitor transportation and storage of dangerous feedstocks against safety guidelines

tasks.design: The manager compares actual handling and storage with current guidelines in {DOCS} and available material records in {OPS_SYSTEM}. A recorded shipment or stock position does not establish safe physical conditions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Dangerous-material safety depends on what is happening at the site.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing material records support monitoring without replacing observation.
tasks.still_hard: Detecting departures from safe handling under changing conditions.
tasks.human_edge: The manager recognises hazards and coordinates escalation.
tasks.altitude: Monitoring responsibility and site presence remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: dangerous-material monitoring remains human; no automated physical safety assessment is established.

assumptions: Boundary is manager monitoring, excluding driver, warehouse and operator handling labour and separate equipment monitoring in task 15458.

Existing suppliers and material-record owners provide material identity and handling information. The manager obtains actual condition observations during s1; no free structured safe-storage or safe-transport flag is assumed.
Use native material records first; existing tracking runtime earns no labour saving.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new monitoring system or reporting demand is introduced.
unknowns: Material hazards, required monitoring and site layout
research_questions: Which unsafe conditions are absent from current transport and stock records?

already_counted.description: Physical condition monitoring and safety interpretation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; net 0%. Physical safety monitoring and guideline interpretation remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Native comparisons can reduce retrospective record gathering while live monitoring, training and safety judgement stay human.
reach: Coordinate data quality and operational follow-up with plant staff.
role.ambitious_version: More traceable production reviews with explicit limits on what dashboards can establish.
